registerRowQuoted.rowVerbatim: | DR-127 | Anti-lockstep compatibility and host-owned control/data race precedence | Protocol + versioning + release owners | [Control demarcation](02-distribution-and-components.md#exact-controldata-plane-demarcation); [compatibility](04-lifecycle-delivery-and-operations.md#separate-compatibility-matrices) | Bidirectional N/N+1 skew, independent rollback/coexistence, no bundle promotion gate; hostile dual-channel race/fault/EOF/duplicate/teardown goldens with byte-opaque provider frames | OPEN | Hard blocker for independent-release blueprint |

linesVerbatim: Anti-lockstep acceptance explicitly tests component N+1 with an unchanged
supported core, core N+1 with unchanged supported components, independent core
and component rollback, concurrent declared generations with incompatible
private dependencies, and bundle selection that does not become a hidden
promotion gate. An aggregate convenience bundle may qualify a selection; it
cannot be the only route by which independently compatible releases work.
Host control events and opaque provider data may race, but precedence remains
host-owned and deterministic. The host defines joins for cancellation versus
result, control fault versus provider fault, EOF/process death, duplicate or
late frames, and teardown. Hostile dual-channel conformance exercises every
ordering while comparing provider semantic frames byte-for-byte: the control
plane may decide supervision/fate only under the owning contract and cannot
translate provider meaning to resolve a race.

passProperties.name: component N+1 + unchanged supported core
passProperties.passProperty: A new independently versioned component release is selectable with the supported core identity unchanged. Record: coreVersion, componentVersion, selectorDecision, non-bundle route used.

passProperties.name: core N+1 + unchanged supported components
passProperties.passProperty: A new independently versioned core release is selectable with a supported component identity unchanged.

passProperties.name: independent core and component rollback
passProperties.passProperty: Either identity can roll back without forcing the other identity to the same version. Counterpart identity bytes remain the previously qualified ones.

passProperties.name: concurrent declared generations with incompatible private dependencies
passProperties.passProperty: Two declared generations may coexist. Their private dependency closures remain distinct. No shared mutable generation pointer.

passProperties.name: bundle selection is not a hidden promotion gate
passProperties.passProperty: A qualifying non-bundle route exists. Bundle may qualify a selection; it cannot be the only route. Compatible unequal-version selection proves the bundle rule.

bundleRule: An aggregate convenience bundle may qualify a selection. It cannot be the only route by which independently compatible releases work. A first contract MUST NOT silently adopt a weaker bundle-only shipping rule. File 11's cost warning is not D-000 authority.
